corrected_fields.summary: This Bank of Canada page is a methodology reference document explaining the Canadian Effective Exchange Rate (CEER) index, which replaced the CERI in January 2018. It describes how the index is constructed using 17 currencies weighted by trade patterns (imports, exports, and third-market competition), with separate sub-indices for major currencies and other important trading partners. Data is available for download in XML, JSON, and CSV formats. No current exchange rate values or market catalyst content is provided.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This page provides foundational methodology for understanding Canada's exchange rate measurement and serves as a data access point. Relevant as a reference for understanding CEER construction, but contains no actionable market catalyst content. The page has no publication date, making it difficult to assess when the methodology was last updated.
corrected_fields.macro_context: The CEER index tracks the Canadian dollar against 17 trading partner currencies using multilateral trade weights. The major currencies sub-index (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CHF, AUD, SEK) captures financial pressure dynamics, while the OITP sub-index captures competitiveness effects. Energy trade is excluded from weights per international standards.
